verdict.rationale: Weave's marketing site says alerts can 'trigger webhook automations', so outbound webhooks appear to be a first-party capability. However, that one sentence (repeated across several items) is the only evidence, and nothing in the docs shows how to register an endpoint or subscribe to specific events. The Slack-notification part of the same claim earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation for registering webhook endpoints, a catalog of subscribable event types, payload schema and signing/retry behavior, programmatic (API) subscription management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
